questions.question: Match each regulatory sign to its meaning.

options.text: Mass limit: vehicles with GVM/GCM above 12 t prohibited

questions.explanation: Sign 1 is R202: Mass limit: vehicles with GVM/GCM above 12 t prohibited. Sign 2 is R205: Length limit 15 m. Sign 3 is R232: Vehicles transporting dangerous substances prohibited. Sign 4 is R203: Axle mass limit 2 t.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs R202 (p.11), R205 (p.11), R232 (p.14), R203 (p.11)

questions.question: Goods carried on a motorcycle may not project more than how far behind the axle of the rear wheel?
questions.explanation: Goods on a motorcycle may not project more than 900 mm to the rear of the rear axle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.35 (p.26)

questions.question: Which control is used before changing the speed of the vehicle?
questions.explanation: The centre rear-view mirror (1).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: During which hours do dedicated lanes (e.g. bus/minibus lanes) apply, unless otherwise indicated?

options.text: 06:00–09:00 and 16:00–18:30, Monday to Friday (not weekends or public holidays)

questions.explanation: No person may drive in a dedicated lane, other than the class shown on the sign, between 06h00–09h00 and 16h00–18h30 Monday to Friday, except weekends and public holidays.
questions.manualRef: National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000, Reg 296A

questions.question: Tap the accelerator in this automatic-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The accelerator is control 10.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: Match each regulatory sign to its meaning.

options.text: Stop – but you may turn left without stopping if you yield to traffic

questions.explanation: Sign 1 is R4.3: One-way roadway straight ahead. Sign 2 is R2.2: Yield at traffic circle (mini-circle) ahead. Sign 3 is R1.2: Stop – but you may turn left without stopping if you yield to traffic. Sign 4 is R2: Yield.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs R4.3 (p.5), R2.2 (p.5), R1.2 (p.4), R2 (p.4)

questions.question: Put these steps for an incline start in an automatic car in the correct order.

options.text: Stop without allowing the vehicle to move backwards

questions.explanation: LMV Module 18 (incline start, automatic transmission).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 18 (p.36)

questions.question: During which speed range is the emergency-stop instruction given in the K53 driving test?

options.text: Above 20 km/h but not more than 40 km/h

questions.explanation: The instruction to stop is only given on a straight road at a speed higher than 20 km/h but not exceeding 40 km/h.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 56 (p.77)

questions.question: When changing down, braking should be completed before the lower gear is selected.
questions.explanation: Braking shall be completed before a lower gear may be selected.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 24 (p.45)

questions.question: What is a "freeway"?

options.text: A public road, or section of it, designated as a freeway by an appropriate road traffic sign
A road with a speed limit of 120 km/h
Any road with more than two lanes

questions.explanation: "Freeway" means a public road or section of a public road designated as a freeway by an appropriate road traffic sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.4)

questions.question: At a four-way stop, who goes first?

options.text: The vehicles (and pedestrians) that arrived at the intersection first

questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, yield to pedestrians and vehicles which arrived at the intersection first.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 37 (p.58)

questions.question: By definition, a "midibus" carries…

options.text: More than 16 but not more than 35 persons, including the driver
More than 9 but not more than 16 persons

questions.explanation: "Midibus" is a sub-category of bus for more than 16 and not more than 35 persons (including the driver).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.5)

questions.question: At an unguarded level crossing, if you must stop, stop at a safe distance or at least ____ from the nearest rail.
questions.explanation: Stop, if necessary, at a safe distance or at least 5 metres from the nearest rail.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 48 (p.69)

questions.question: You may stop for a short period on a yellow no-parking line.
questions.explanation: No parking line (RM13): you may stop for short periods but may not park.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM13 (p.51)

questions.question: How must a motorcycle rider be seated?

options.text: Any position as long as one hand is on the handlebars
Astride the saddle with feet on the front footrests

questions.explanation: A rider must be seated astride on the saddle with feet resting on the front footrests.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.50 (p.33)

questions.question: Your foot may rest on the clutch pedal while the engine is running, except in stop-start traffic.
questions.explanation: The foot may not rest on the clutch pedal whilst the engine is running, except in stop-start traffic.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 11 (p.27)

questions.question: Put these actions after an accident in the order given in the manual.

options.text: Ascertain the nature and extent of any damage
Ascertain the nature and extent of any injuries

questions.explanation: The listed duties: immediately stop; ascertain injuries; render assistance; ascertain damage; give details; report within 24 h if needed.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.62 (p.37)

questions.question: In this manual-transmission car, what is control number 6?
questions.explanation: Control 6 is the gear lever.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Right turn prohibited (you may go straight or turn left)"?
questions.explanation: Right turn prohibited (R212): you may proceed straight or turn left.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R212 (p.12)

questions.question: Match each motorcycle load projection to its maximum.

options.text: In front of the front axle

questions.explanation: Motorcycle loads: 600 mm front, 900 mm rear, 450 mm either side, 300 mm outside the sidecar wheel.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.35 (p.26)

questions.question: If the brakes of a heavy vehicle fail on the descent indicated by this sign, what should the driver do?

options.text: Drive straight into the arrestor bed

questions.explanation: Arrestor bed (GS501–GS504): should the brakes of your vehicle fail, drive straight into the arrestor bed.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §5.3 GS501 (p.44)

questions.question: Where there is a sidewalk next to the roadway, when may a pedestrian walk on the roadway?

options.text: Only to cross it or for some other sufficient reason

questions.explanation: Where a sidewalk or footpath abuts the roadway, a pedestrian shall not walk on the roadway except to cross or for some other sufficient reason.
questions.manualRef: National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000, Reg 316(1)

questions.question: A person whose driving licence is suspended by a court may apply for a learner's licence while the suspension is in force.
questions.explanation: A person is disqualified while a licence suspension by a competent court remains in force.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – §4.1 Disqualification (p.11)

questions.question: Which foot pedals does a manual car have? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Controls 8, 9 and 10 are the pedals: clutch, brake and accelerator.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: Tap the clutch in this manual-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The clutch is control 8.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: This sign means: "Low-flying aircraft".
questions.explanation: False. Congestion (W355): possibility of congested traffic. ("Low-flying aircraft" is the meaning of W351.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W355 (p.32)

questions.question: If you did not give your details to a traffic officer at the scene of an accident, within how long must you report it at a police station?
questions.explanation: If details were not furnished to a traffic officer at the scene, report the accident at a police station within 24 hours.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.62 (p.37)

questions.question: Yellow reflective material must be fitted to goods vehicles with a GVM exceeding ____.
questions.explanation: From 1 January 2001, yellow reflective material must be fitted to goods vehicles with a GVM exceeding 10 000 kg.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.44 (p.29)

questions.question: Which control is used before changing the direction of a vehicle?
questions.explanation: The indicator light switch (5).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: This sign means: "Goods vehicles only".
questions.explanation: False. Agricultural vehicles only (R130). ("Goods vehicles only" is the meaning of R123.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R130 (p.9)

questions.question: This sign means you must turn left at the intersection ahead.
questions.explanation: Turn left only (R108): turn in the direction of the arrow at the intersection ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R108 (p.6)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Length restriction ahead (15 m)".
questions.explanation: Length restricted (W321): vehicles longer than shown cannot negotiate the road ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W321 (p.28)

questions.question: Yellow side retro-reflectors are required on a vehicle or combination whose overall length exceeds ____.
questions.explanation: Vehicles or combinations longer than 7 m need yellow side retro-reflectors no more than 3,6 m apart.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.43 (p.29)

questions.question: At an intersection, you should check right and left only after you have entered it.
questions.explanation: On approach, look right, left and ahead; you are penalised for only checking after entering the intersection.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 36 (p.57)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Advance exit direction sign (about 1 km before the off-ramp)
Gore exit sign: pass left to exit, right to stay on the freeway

questions.explanation: Gore exit (GA4): pass on its left if leaving the freeway and on its right if not.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §5.2 GA4 (p.42)

questions.question: This sign means: "Agricultural vehicles prohibited".
questions.explanation: False. Speed limit (R201): do not exceed the speed shown; the restriction applies from the sign. ("Agricultural vehicles prohibited" is the meaning of R236.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R201 (p.11)

questions.question: A hand signal should be used together with the direction indicators, which must be switched on before the hand signal is given.
questions.explanation: The hand signal shall be used in conjunction with direction indicators which shall be activated prior to the hand signal.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 7 (p.23)

questions.question: The legal limit for alcohol in the blood of an ordinary driver is less than ____ per 100 ml of blood.
questions.explanation: No person shall drive with a blood alcohol concentration of 0,05 g per 100 ml or more.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.65 (p.38)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Keep left (pass to the left of the obstruction)

questions.explanation: Cyclists and pedestrians only (R112–R115): only cyclists and/or pedestrians may use this road or part of the road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R112 (p.7)

questions.question: When a vehicle has stopped at a pedestrian crossing, you may pass it if you are careful.
questions.explanation: Whenever any vehicle has stopped at a pedestrian crossing, the driver of any other vehicle may not pass the stopped vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.53 (p.34)

questions.question: What is the maximum turning radius allowed for a vehicle?
questions.explanation: A vehicle may not be used if its turning radius exceeds 13,1 m.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.13 (p.19)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No freeway ahead for vehicles under 50 cc
The freeway ends here and freeway rules no longer apply

questions.explanation: A red cross over a sign is a de-restriction sign (R600): here it cancels the freeway (R401).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.5 R401-600 (p.22)

questions.question: In a roundabout (traffic circle), you intend to leave at the third exit. When must you signal left?

options.text: In good time before your exit

questions.explanation: When intending to leave the roundabout at any subsequent exit, the left signal shall be activated in good time prior to the exit.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 45 (p.66)

questions.question: Put these steps for stopping in traffic (manual car) in the correct order.

options.text: Stop with clear space behind the vehicle ahead

questions.explanation: LMV Module 29 (stopping in traffic, manual transmission).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 29 (p.50)

questions.question: By definition, a "motor car" is designed to carry…

options.text: Not more than 9 persons, including the driver

questions.explanation: "Motor car" means a motor vehicle (not a motorcycle, tricycle or quadrucycle) designed to carry not more than nine persons, including the driver.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.5)

questions.question: Why is this sign used before an intersection?

options.text: To show the end of a stop street
A traffic officer is stopping all vehicles
A four-way stop has been replaced by traffic lights
The stop sign ahead cannot be seen in time

questions.explanation: Traffic control "STOP" ahead (W302): there is a stop sign ahead which cannot be seen in time.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W302 (p.26)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Steep ascent ahead"?
questions.explanation: Steep ascent (W322): the road climbs steeply; be aware of slow-moving traffic.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W322 (p.28)

questions.question: Which of these is a foot control?
questions.explanation: The brake (9) is a foot control.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.11 Sample questions (p.15)

questions.question: In an urban area you may not park on a roadway that is less than ____ wide.
questions.explanation: No parking on a roadway less than 5,5 m wide in an urban area.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.47 (p.31)

questions.question: You may drive, pull or push a vehicle on a sidewalk.
questions.explanation: No person may drive, pull or push a vehicle upon a sidewalk.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.49 (p.32)

questions.question: After this sign, look out for wild animals for the next ____.
questions.explanation: Wild animals (W313): be on the lookout for the next 2 km.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W313 (p.28)

questions.question: A motorcyclist should keep fingers resting on the clutch lever while riding.
questions.explanation: The fingers may not rest on the clutch lever while the motorcycle is in motion, except in stop-start traffic.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Motor Cycles manual Part 1, Module 11 (p.28)

questions.question: You may spin your wheels on the road surface when pulling away, provided nobody is endangered.
questions.explanation: You may not cause any wheel to drag or spin on the roadway surface, except in an emergency.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.55 (p.35)

questions.question: Match each warning sign to its meaning.

options.text: Side road junction from the right
Staggered junction: side road from the right first, then from the left

questions.explanation: Sign 1 is W108: Side road junction from the right. Sign 2 is W118: Beginning of dual roadway. Sign 3 is W109: Staggered junction: side road from the right first, then from the left. Sign 4 is W104: T-junction ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs W108 (p.23), W118 (p.24), W109 (p.24), W104 (p.23)

questions.question: What is a "motor tricycle"?

options.text: A pedal cycle with a small engine
A three-wheeled motor vehicle designed to be driven with the controls usually fitted to a motorcycle

questions.explanation: "Motor tricycle" means a motor vehicle (not a motorcycle or tractor) with three wheels designed to be driven by motorcycle-type controls.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.5)

questions.question: Link each regulatory sign with its correct meaning.

options.text: Parking (vehicles under 3 500 kg GVM, no time limit, fee payable)
Reserved for vehicles of disabled persons

questions.explanation: Sign 1 is R321: Reserved for ambulances/emergency vehicles. Sign 2 is R323: Reserved for vehicles of disabled persons. Sign 3 is R301-P: Parking reserved for buses. Sign 4 is R305-P: Parking (vehicles under 3 500 kg GVM, no time limit, fee payable).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs R321 (p.18), R323 (p.18), R301-P (p.16), R305-P (p.16)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Left turn ahead prohibited"?
questions.explanation: Left turn ahead prohibited (R209): do not turn left at the intersection ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R209 (p.12)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Reserved for authorised vehicles (e.g. diplomatic corps)

questions.explanation: Motorcycle reservation (R307): do not use this road if you are not riding a motorcycle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.4 R307 (p.16)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?
questions.explanation: Uneven roadway (W331): a depression, ridge or potholes ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W331 (p.29)

questions.question: Which of these may you NOT do on a channelising line (RM3)?

options.text: Cross it with any part of your vehicle

questions.explanation: Channelizing line (RM3): drive in such a way that no part of your vehicle crosses the line.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM3 (p.48)

questions.question: Which of these conditions can disqualify a person from holding a licence? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Sudden attacks of disabling giddiness or fainting
Wearing glasses that correct the vision to standard

questions.explanation: Disqualifying conditions include disabling giddiness or fainting, muscular incoordination, defective vision by the prescribed standard, and others listed.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – §4.1 Disqualification (p.11–12)

questions.question: Which of these is an offence for a driver? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Following another vehicle more closely than is reasonable
Depositing oil or fuel on the road
Allowing the engine to emit avoidable smoke

questions.explanation: These are all prohibited general duties of a driver (6.49).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.49 (p.32)

questions.question: Put these steps for an emergency stop in the correct order.

options.text: Bring the vehicle to a controlled stop in the shortest possible distance
Apply the service brake on the instruction to stop

questions.explanation: LMV Module 56: apply the service brake on instruction, then stop in a controlled manner within the shortest possible distance.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 56 (p.77)

questions.question: Where are you NOT allowed to park? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Where your vehicle would obscure a road traffic sign
In front of a private driveway entrance

questions.explanation: You may not park so as to encroach on a sidewalk, obstruct a vehicular entrance, or obscure a road traffic sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.47 (p.31)

questions.question: Tap the accelerator in this manual-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The accelerator is control 10.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: How does driving on the road surface indicated by this sign affect your vehicle? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: A longer stopping distance is needed

questions.explanation: Gravel road begins (W325): steering will be lighter, vehicles skid more easily and need a longer stopping distance.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W325 (p.29)

questions.question: Under which conditions may you drive to the left of this line while being overtaken? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: If it can be done without endangering anyone
At night when the road is quiet
If persons and vehicles are visible for at least 150 m

questions.explanation: Left-edge line (RM4.1): you may drive there only while being overtaken, if safe, during daytime and if persons and vehicles are visible for at least 150 m.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM4.1 (p.49)

questions.question: Which controls must you use to change a gear? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: The gear lever (6) and the clutch (8).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Tap the hand brake (parking brake) in this automatic-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The hand brake (parking brake) is control 7.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Excessive noise prohibited (no hooting for 100 m)"?
questions.explanation: Excessive noise prohibited (R206): noisy vehicles may not proceed, and the hooter may not be used for 100 m after the sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R206 (p.11)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Delineator plate: do not pass to the left of it"?
questions.explanation: Delineator plate (W402): do not pass to the left of W402.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W402 (p.33)

questions.question: Match each regulatory sign to its meaning.
questions.explanation: Sign 1 is R210: Right turn ahead prohibited. Sign 2 is R209: Left turn ahead prohibited. Sign 3 is R219: Pedal cycles prohibited. Sign 4 is R236: Agricultural vehicles prohibited.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs R210 (p.12), R209 (p.12), R219 (p.13), R236 (p.15)

questions.question: Neutral should never be selected while the vehicle is ____.
questions.explanation: Neutral shall never be selected whilst the vehicle is in motion.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Coasting (p.80)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Narrow bridge ahead"?
questions.explanation: Narrow bridge (W326): the road narrows on a bridge; avoid crossing at the same time as an oncoming vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W326 (p.29)

questions.question: You may overtake on the left by driving on the shoulder if the vehicle ahead is turning right.
questions.explanation: In no event shall any passing be done by driving on the shoulder or the verge.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.45 (p.29)

questions.question: Which learner's licence code is required to ride a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Code 1 is the motorcycle learner's licence.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.1 (p.12)

questions.question: In this manual-transmission car, what is control number 3?
questions.explanation: Control 3 is the left and right rear-view mirrors.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Warthog (W358).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W358 (p.33)

questions.question: Before you change direction you use the ____ to advise other road users of your intention.
questions.explanation: The indicator light switch (5) is used before changing direction.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Collision scene ahead".
questions.explanation: Collision (TW353): the road may be obstructed; do not stop out of curiosity.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 TW353 (p.32)

questions.question: Which control is used to advise other road users of your intention to steer or turn to the left or right?
questions.explanation: The indicator light switch (5).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: What must you do at a steady red traffic light?

options.text: Stop only if there is cross traffic

questions.explanation: At a steady red light: check mirrors, decelerate, brake and stop.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 41 (p.62)

questions.question: What does this road marking indicate?
questions.explanation: Railway crossing ahead marking (WM1).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.2 WM1 (p.52)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate on a freeway?

options.text: A 300 m stretch of road works

questions.explanation: Countdown signs (IN3, IN2, IN1): an exit about 300 m, 200 m and 100 m ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §6 IN3 (p.46)

questions.question: On an uphill where speed drops despite full use of the accelerator, when should you change down?

options.text: Before the speed drops so far that the lower gear will not serve its purpose or the engine labours
At the top of the hill
Only after the car has almost stopped

questions.explanation: Change down before the speed drops to a point where the lower gear will not serve its purpose or the engine starts labouring.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 24 (p.45)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Combined curves: first sharp curve to the right"?
questions.explanation: Combined curves (W210): two sharp curves in opposite directions, the first to the right.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W210 (p.25)

questions.question: Which vehicles need only a rear number plate? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Number plates go on the back of a motorcycle, motor tricycle or trailer, and on the front and back of all other motor vehicles.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.8 (p.17)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Agricultural vehicles may cross or enter the road

questions.explanation: Traffic control ahead (TW304): a traffic officer is controlling traffic ahead; be ready to stop.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 TW304 (p.27)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Multi-phase traffic signals: your signal may stay red while oncoming traffic gets green
You have right of way at the intersection ahead
Co-ordinated traffic signals: keep to 55 km/h for green lights

questions.explanation: Co-ordinated traffic signals (IN14): signals will be green if you keep the indicated speed; it is a recommendation, not a limit.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §6 IN14 (p.47)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: General warning: danger of some kind ahead
Pedestrians may be crossing for the next 2 km

questions.explanation: Congestion (W355): possibility of congested traffic.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W355 (p.32)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Multi-phase traffic signals: your signal may stay red while oncoming traffic gets green
Co-ordinated traffic signals: keep to 55 km/h for green lights

questions.explanation: Information centre (IN12).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §6 IN12 (p.46)

questions.question: Which colours may rear direction indicators show?
questions.explanation: Rear indicators: yellow, amber or red.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.42 (p.28)

questions.question: What does this temporary sign warn you about?

options.text: Police on duty ahead (e.g. roadblock or temporary stop) – be ready to stop

questions.explanation: Temporary police flashing light (TW347): a temporary stop sign, collision scene or roadblock where police are on duty.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 TW347 (p.31)

questions.question: Which sign means: "T-junction ahead"?
questions.explanation: T-junction (W104): you will have to turn sharp left or right; slow down and be prepared to stop.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.1 W104 (p.23)

questions.question: Link each regulatory sign with its correct meaning.

options.text: Divided path: cyclists on one side, pedestrians on the other

questions.explanation: Sign 1 is R126: Vehicles transporting dangerous substances only. Sign 2 is R113: Divided path: cyclists on one side, pedestrians on the other. Sign 3 is R121: Buses only. Sign 4 is R108: Turn left ahead only.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs R126 (p.8), R113 (p.7), R121 (p.8), R108 (p.6)

questions.question: Put these steps for exiting a freeway in the correct order.

options.text: Check rear-view mirror(s) and appropriate blind spot
Maintain speed where possible and enter the off-ramp

questions.explanation: LMV Module 54 order: mirrors/blind spot, signal, check blind spots, maintain speed and enter off-ramp, cancel signal, check mirrors, decelerate.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 54 (p.75)

questions.question: Where there is no sidewalk, on which side of the roadway should a pedestrian walk?

options.text: In the middle of the road
On the left-hand edge, with the traffic
As near as practicable to the right-hand edge, facing oncoming traffic

questions.explanation: A pedestrian on a road without a sidewalk shall walk near the edge of the roadway on his or her right-hand side so as to face oncoming traffic.
questions.manualRef: National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000, Reg 316(2)

questions.question: Put these final steps for stopping to park a manual car in the correct order.

options.text: Check mirrors and blind spots before opening doors
Cancel signal and switch off accessories

questions.explanation: LMV Module 31 (stopping for parking, manual transmission).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 31 (p.52)

questions.question: When must the headlamps of a vehicle be switched on?

options.text: From sunset to sunrise only on freeways
From sunset to sunrise, and whenever persons and vehicles cannot be clearly seen at 150 m

questions.explanation: Headlamps must be on from sunset to sunrise and at any other time when persons and vehicles are not clearly discernible at a distance of 150 m.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.1.2 (p.16)

questions.question: When leaving a freeway, what should you do on entering the off-ramp?

options.text: Maintain speed where possible, enter the off-ramp and then decelerate
Brake hard on the freeway before the off-ramp
Stop at the start of the off-ramp

questions.explanation: Freeway exit: signal, check blind spots, maintain speed where possible and enter the off-ramp, cancel signal, check mirrors and decelerate.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 54 (p.75)
